title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of workers' organizations

description.narrative: This Country Programme outcome is designed to enhance the role of trade unions in Rwanda—specifically Confederation of Trade Unions of Rwanda (CESTRAR), the Confederation of Trade Unions of Rwanda (COTRAF), and the National Union of Workers (COSYLI) — in promoting sustainable job creation and expanding social protection coverage for all workers. In alignment with the Global Accelerator on Jobs and Social Protection for Just Transitions launched by the UN Secretary-General, this program focuses on building the capacity of workers' organizations to influence national policies and strategies that address pressing employment and social protection challenges. Rwanda's commitment to this initiative marks it as a potential "Pathfinder country," reflecting the government's dedication to fostering extensive social dialogue and tripartism among social partners. This program uniquely recognizes the significant challenges faced by workers, particularly those in informal and vulnerable sectors, compounded by the effects of COVID-19 and the rapid changes brought on by climate change and technological advancements. Through capacity-building workshops, the development of strategic position papers, and the establishment of advocacy agendas, the initiative ensures that workers have a strong voice in policy formulation. It emphasizes the importance of tailoring social protection systems to address the needs of all segments of society, especially marginalized groups including women, migrants, and individuals with disabilities. Moreover, the initiative aims to reduce inequalities and promote gender equality in the workplace by integrating ILO standards and practices that address pay discrimination and labor rights. By empowering trade unions to advocate for effective social protection systems and equitable employment opportunities, the program aims to significantly contribute to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), specifically targeting poverty reduction, decent work
